/* ===================================================================== 7. dbo.GetDateOfBirthCertificatePrintData
CertificateNumber is derived the same way Leave Certificate / Character Certificate derive theirs - a formatted string built from the identity column, not a separately stored/tracked sequence. It is printed on the report as "S. No." to match the school's existing paper certificate.
SchoolName is pulled LIVE from dbo.SchoolProfile at print time (never snapshotted onto the certificate row itself), same reasoning already documented in SchoolProfile_Schema.sql: the school's own identity does not change per-certificate, and any later correction to the school's profile should be reflected on certificates printed afterwards.
DateOfBirthInFigures/DateOfBirthInWords are pre-formatted here in SQL (same approach already used for CertificateNumber) so the report itself stays a simple field-binding layout with no date arithmetic of its own: DateOfBirthInFigures -> "01-04-1998" DateOfBirthInWords -> "01st, April, 1998" ===================================================================== */
